(I)--a son of व्यास and अरणी and a great yogin; superior to his father as a yogi; seeing him firm in renuncia- tion, व्यास taught him the भागवत; renounced worldly life before his upanayana. Wandered naked from place to place and reached the country of कुरुजान्गलस्. When at हास्तिनापुर he stopped for a few minutes at the threshold of householders to purify their abode.
1: भा. I. 2. 2-3; 4. 2-8; 7. 8; M. १५. 8.
सूत's salutation to: called on परीक्षित् doing प्रायोपवेश and imparted know- ledge to him, addressed by the king as to the best way of spending his last moments for attaining मोक्ष। Enlightened [page३-437+ ३४] him by the भागवत episodes;
2: Ib. I. १२. 3; १९. २५-39; 1. 3; XII. 6. 8.
went with कृष्ण to मिथिला, and to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse. Took part in defending द्वारका against शाल्व.
3: Ib. X. ८६. १८; ७६. १४; ८२. 6.
On सौर गण as seven for each month. Heard the story of Citraketu from व्यास, नारद and Devala.
4: Ib. XII. ११. २७; VI. १४. 9.
In the form of a Brahman; one of the twelve who knew the धर्म ordained by Hari.
5: Ib. XII. १३. २१; VI. 3. २०.
A Madhya- माध्वर्यु; married पीवरी and got by her five sons all योगा- चार्यस् and a daughter कीर्तिमती, a योगिनी; of superior bhakti; (married पीवरी, the mind-born daughter of the बर्हिषद् Manes and had by her a daughter and four sons-म्। प्।) the sons were कृष्ण, Gama, Prabhu, शम्भु and भूरिश्रुत.
6: Br. I. 1. १५०; II. ३३. १४; III. 8. ९२-4; १०. ८०-82; ३४. ३८; M. १५. 8; वा. ७०. ८४; ७३. २८; १०८. ४२ and ६०.
(II)--a son of गार्हपत्य agni. Br. II. १२. १२.
(III)--a son of शरभ and father of ऋक्ष. Br. III. 7. २०७.
(IV)--the father-in-law of अणुह. M. ४९. ५७; वा. ९९. १७९.
--a deva गण. वा. १०. २१.
--a R. of the केतुमाला continent. वा. ४४. १८. [page३-438+ २६]
--a Janapada of the केतुमाला continent. वा. ४४. १३.
--a name of ललिता. Br. IV. १७. ३३ and ४४.
(I)--loved by अग्नी. भा. IV. २४. ११.

(II)--a daughter of ताम्रा and कश्यप; married Garutmat and had six sons त्रिशिर, Sumukha, Bala, पृष्ट, त्रिशन्कुनेत्र and Surasa who had in their turn a number of sons and grandsons;
1: Br. III. 7. 8-9, ४४६; वा. ६९. ३२८-30.
brought forth parrots and owls; gave birth to parrots, owls, and crows (वि। प्।)
2: M. 6. ३०-31; Vi. I. २१. १५-16.
--heat making rays of the sun. वा. ५३. २२.
--(Kulaparvata) a hill in भारतवर्ष. भा. V. १९. १६; Br. II. १६. १८; वा. ४५. ८९, १०७; Vi. II. 3. 3.
--a R. from the ऋक्ष hill. Br. II. १६. ३१; वा. ४५. १०१.
--a R. from the ऋष्यवान्. M. ११४. २६.
--a kulaparvata. M. ११४. १७ and ३२.
(III)--the month sacred to मीत्र. भा. XII. ११. ३५; Br. II. १३. 9; वा. ३०. 8.
(IV)--the नाग presiding over the month of शुचि. भा. XII. ११. ३६.
(V)--a son of ऊरु and आग्नेयी. Br. II. ३६. १०८.
(VI)--a name of शिव. Br. III. ७२. १८३.
(VII)--one of the twenty Sutapa गणस्. Br. IV. 1. १४; वा. १००. १४.
(VIII)--a son of ऊर्जा and वसिष्ठ: a sage of the epoch of Bhautya Manu; of the XIV epoch of Manu. Br. IV. 1. ११३; Vi. I. १०. १३; III. 2. ४४.
(IX)--a son of हविर्धान. M. 4. ४६.
(X)--a son of Auttama Manu; married गौट् the mind-born daughter of the मानस Pitr2s. M. 9. २०; १५. १५.
(XI)--a son of सावर्णि Manu; the hero. M. 9. ३३.

(XII)--a son of प्रजापति and overlord of Daityas;
1: वा. १०. ७२; ३८. ६२; ५३. ३३.
mother of, brought back to life by भृगु.
2: Ib. 1. १५०.
[page३-442+ २४]
(XIII)--the शुक्ल Paks2a. वा. ५२. ३७.
(XIV)--a son of Jala or waters. Vi. I. 8. ११.
(XV)--a son of Nandana. Vi. IV. २४. ५६.
--the mind-born sons of स्वायम्भुव Manu; १२ in number, all सोमपायिन्स्--a गण. Br. II. 9. ४६; १२. ४७; वा. ३१. 4. 8-9.
--the second son of गार्हपत्य. वा. २९. ११.
--on the south bank of the नर्मदा; sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. २९; १९१. २०-21.
--a queen of ग्रीष्म r2tu. Br. IV. ३२. २५.

--a portion of the Vedic literature, the Yajur Veda;
1: Br. II. ३५; ७७; वा. ६१. ६८.
to be uttered in installing a new deity.
2: M. २६५. २६.
(I)--a name of Hari. भा. III. २१. ३५. [page३-443+ २८]
(II)--a son of हविर्धान. भा. IV. २४. 8; Br. II. ३७. २४.
(III)--a Mt. in क्रौञ्चद्वीप. भा. V. २०. २१.
(V)--one of the seven sons of वसिष्ठ. वा. २८. ३६.
(I)--a R. in क्रौञ्चद्वीप. भा. V. २०. २१.
(II)--same as Vidyut. M. १२२. ७३.
--the two ayanams. वा. ३१. ३०.
(I)--a son of बलराम. Br. III. ७१. १६७.
(II)--a son of सारण. वा. ९६. १६५.
--on account of the distance of the rising sun the reflection of agni and waters is white, and of earth dark and red when there is no ray; and hot owing to this reddishness. वा. ५०. ११०.

--sacred to शिव; merits of expounded to शिव to मार्कण्डेय; attached to the नर्मदा; here चाणक्य a राजऋषि attained siddhi; destroys the sin of brahmicide and infanticide; the lord lives here with उमा on the fourteenth day of the dark half of वैशाख and Caitra months. Prayers [page३-444+ २८] on the fourteenth day of the कृत्तिका month takes one to the abode of शिव. M. १९२. 3, १२-38.
--near Benares. M. १८३. ६२.
--a group of नाडीस् of the sun emitting heat. Br. II. २४. ३०.
--the name of व्यास of the २२न्द् dva1para; लान्गलि, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १९८.
--a hell, intended for the five heinous offences. Br. IV. 2. १४६, १५४.
--a kind of hell; here fall the slayers of Brahmans, consumers of spirituous liquors, stealers of gold, etc. वा. १०१. १४६, १५२; Vi. II. 6. 2 and 9. [page३-679+ २५]

(I)--A daughter of सयाति: when once she went with her father to the hermitage of Cyavana, she saw an anthill with two luminous objects in holes which she pricked with a thorn. This resulted in blood-flowing from the eyes of the sage Cyavana. The king asked the sage's pardon by giving his daughter in marriage. अश्विन्स् called on them and made Cyavana look young to the puzzle of सुकन्या. The अश्विन्स् revealed to her of Cyavana's rejuvena- tion. Once her father came and seeing her with a young man, he took him to be her paramour and scolded her. But when he heard the truth of the matter he was pleased. भा. IV. 3. 2-२३; Br. III. 1. ९३; 8. ३१; २५. ८०; ६१. १९; M. १२. २१; वा. ६५. ९०; ८६. २३. Vi. IV. 1. ६२.
(II)--mother of Sumedhas. वा. ७०. २६.
--a son of देवयनी, and an यक्ष. Br. III. 7. १२९.
(I)--a son of श्वफल्क. भा. IX. २४. १६; Br. III. ७१. ११२.

(II)--A son of सुन्वा(na): an illustrious pupil of Jaimini and author of the समन् with a thousand [page३-607+ २८] सम्हितस्। His pupils were हिरण्यनाभ and पौष्यञ्जि, besides an आवन्त्य: Had ५०० disciples from the north and a good number from the east.
1: भा. XII. 6. ७६-78; वा. ६१. २७-32.
The story goes that as he taught the सम्हितस् on अनध्ययन days, Indra killed his pupils. At this the sage took to प्रायोपवेस, and Indra ap- peased him by saying that he would have two best pupils alive, and these were हिरण्यनाभ and पौष्यञ्जि.
2: Br. II. ३५. ३२; Vi. III. 6. 2-3.
--gods of the epoch of the १३थ् Manu. भा. VIII. १३. ३१.
(I)--a group of gods of the epoch of Raucya Manu: Gods of the fourth सावर्ण Manu. Br. IV. 1. ८४ & ८८, ९७, १००; वा. १००. ८७.
(II)--one of the three देवगणस् of the १३थ् Manu; oblation given to them are curds and ghee. वा. १००. १०१, १०४; Vi. III. 2. ३८.
(III)--a group of Gods of the XII epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 2. ३४.
--one of the eight sons of महापद्म, all of whom ruled only for १२ years. M. २७२. २१.
--a Janapada of the भद्रा continent. वा. ४३. २०. [page३-608+ २६]

--the पितृस्, sons of वसिष्ठ--हिरण्य garbha, propitiated by शूद्रस् in ceremonies: मानस is their king- dom: The R. नर्मदा is their mind-born daughter (मानसि Kanya1 नर्मदा). Br. III. १०. ९६-7. वा. ७३. ४६-8.
--a class of पितृस्. M. १०२. २१.
--a sage of the second सावर्ण epoch. Br. IV. 1. ६९.
(I)--King: a son of धृष्टकेतु and father of वीतिहोत्र. भा. IX. १७. 9.
(II)--a son of Havya: after him सुकुमार vars2a. Br. II. १४. १७-19; वा. ३३. १६.
(III)--a son of Suvibhu and father of धृष्टकेतु. Br. III. ६७. ७६; वा. ९२. ७१; Vi. IV. 8. २०.
(IV)--a son of Bhavya of शाकद्वीप. Vi. II. 4. ६०.
--a kingdom of शाकद्वीप down the Jalada hill; named after सुकुमार. Br. II. १४. १९; १९. ९१; M. १२२. २१; वा. ३३. १८. ४९. ८६.
(I)--a son of वसिष्ठ and a प्रजापति of the स्वारोचिष epoch. M. 9. 9.
(II)--a son of पृथु. M. ४९. ५५.
(III)--a sage of the X epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 2. २७.
(II)--a R. of the शाकद्वीप. M. १२२. ३३.
(I)--a sage of the epoch of the Tenth Manu. भा. VIII. १३. २२.
(III)--a son of पृथु and father of विभ्राज. Vi. IV. १९. ४२.
--a R. from ऋष्यवान्. M. ११४. २५.
--son of सुनीथ, and father Dharmaketu. भा. IX. १७. 8. [page३-610+ २४]
(I)--a son of Nandivardhana of Magadha, and father of देवरात; a bold and righteous king. भा. IX. १३. १४; Br. III. ६४. 7; वा. ८९. 7; Vi. IV. 5. २५. Br. III. ६४. 7.
(II)--a son of Uttama Manu. Br. II. ३६. ४०; वा. ६२. ३५.
(III)--a दानव. Br. III. 6. 6; वा. ६८. 6.
(IV)--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २४३.
(V)--a son of Sagara. Br. III. ६३. १४७.
(VI)--a son of केतुमान्: father of Dharma- ketu. Br. III. ६७. ७४.
(VII)--a son of सुनीथ; a righteous monarch; father of Dharmaketu. वा. ९२. ६९-70; Vi. IV. 8. १९.
(I)--a sage in दारुवन. Br. II. २७. १०४.
--a daughter of Tumburu. Br. III. 7. १३; IV. ३३. १९; वा. ६९. ४९.
--a बृहद्रथ: ruled Magadha for ५६ years. Br. III. ७४. ११२.
(I)--a son of the second सावर्ण Manu. Br. IV. 1. ७१.
(II)--a son of ब्रह्मसावर्णि Manu. Vi. III. 2. २८.
--one of the twenty-eight hells, intended for the king or his officials who punish the innocent, and Brahmans with corporal punishment. भा. V. २६. 7 and १६.
--relating to ब्रह्मा Vis2n2u, Arka, Rudra, Indra, Agni, Soma; to be recited at the श्राद्ध. M. १७. ३७; २४६. ६०.
--a third योगैश्वर्य and पञ्चभूताम्तक; indiriyas, manas, buddhi, and अहङ्कार. वा. १३. 5.
--seven in number; these with the भूत result in ऐश्वर्य and ऐश्वर्य results in its turn in राग or desire while ब्रह्मा is विराग or void of राग the सूक्ष्म भाव is प्रस्थूल bha1va. वा. १२. २७-32.
--the goddess following Bhava मालिनी. M. १७९. ७१.
